summary: Completed testing of Categories with Dynamic Checklists feature for Actoos SaaS. All 8 tests passed - 8 backend API tests (100%) and 3 frontend UI tests (100%). Categories are seeded automatically with 6 default types (Plomberie, Électricité, BTP, Nettoyage, Climatisation, Maintenance), each with a checklist template. Technicians can fill checklists on the field.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend seed_categories_for_entreprise() correctly seeds 6 default categories on first GET /categories call
ChecklistResponse model properly handles checkbox, text, number, and photo types with completed_at timestamps
Frontend CreateInterventionForm includes category selector with colored indicators
ChecklistView component correctly renders different input types (checkbox, text, number, photo) based on item.type
PUT /interventions/{id}/checklist correctly validates tech ownership before allowing updates
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed interventions with categories during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Categories with Checklists feature fully tested and working. Key endpoints: GET /categories (returns 6 default categories with checklist_template), GET /categories/{id} (returns specific category), POST /interventions with categorie_id (links intervention to category), PUT /interventions/{id}/checklist (saves checklist responses), GET /interventions/{id} (returns checklist_responses). Frontend shows category selector in intervention form with 6 colored options, and intervention details display the checklist with checkbox/text/number inputs.
